en.title: The Largest Electric Aircraft Just Flew [video]
en.hook: A major technical milestone for zero-emission flight as the largest electric aircraft completes its flight test.
key_takeaways: Successful maiden flight of the world's largest electric-powered aircraft
Crucial milestone toward decarbonizing short-to-medium haul aviation
Validates real-world performance of high-capacity electric propulsion systems

zh.title: 史上最大型电动飞机成功试飞 [视频]
zh.hook: 迈向零排放航空的关键一步，迄今为止尺寸最大的纯电动飞机成功完成试飞。
key_takeaways: 迄今为止全球最大型电动飞机成功完成首次试飞
航空业去碳化与绿色可持续发展的重要里程碑
验证了大容量电动推进系统与电池技术的实际可行性
